docsKeyRules: ARCHITECTURE §3: the API is the only authority for business rules and authorization; Next.js is not the business backend (no Prisma, no business rule in apps/web).

ARCHITECTURE §4: apps/web is responsible for public discovery, role workspaces, TanStack Query server state, RHF + Zod forms using the same @xr/validation/@xr/contracts schemas; NOT for business rules, entitlement derivation, licence arithmetic or authorization decisions. Phase 0 delivers only wiring proof (/, /system, /healthz).

ARCHITECTURE §6: boundaries declared once (boundary-matrix.mjs), enforced by ESLint xr/resolved-boundaries, the dependency-matrix test and package exports; apps/web never depends on @xr/database or @xr/api.
ARCHITECTURE §7: tenant = institution (or campus/operational unit); no sub-tenant level (STK31-23); Super Admin spans both planes; analytics never cross a tenant.

ARCHITECTURE §8: learner entitlement, Faculty scope, licence allocation, per-technology progress, access-term state and simulation utilisation are DERIVED, never stored as truth; prefer reversible status over deletion; a completion is never walked back.

ARCHITECTURE §9: authorization from a server-resolved Principal; roles student | faculty | tenant_admin | vendor | academic_reviewer | content_manager | super_admin; platform-role scopes all | course | experiment; Vendor never publishes; first publication = Content Manager; later-version Release / Hold = Super Admin; Tenant Admin cannot assign outside the approved set; Student never sees an answer key.
ARCHITECTURE §10: OIDC/OAuth 2.0; Next.js as relying party (BFF vs browser tokens open, E-02); Phase 0 — 'No authentication is implemented and none is faked'.

ARCHITECTURE §11: five runtime events, no content event; ingestion only if the Student may run that technology at that moment; complete for a technology ONLY with SIMULATION_COMPLETED on an actually opened session; progress per technology (STK31-36); no aggregate with a technology denominator while D-09-13 is open. Open: R1/D25 completion condition, R2, R7, R8, R9.
ARCHITECTURE §13: testing layers — domain unit, contract, component (Vitest + RTL jsdom), API integration, DB-backed (uncached), Playwright e2e, boundaries, functional parity (not started).

ARCHITECTURE §14: three environments validated by @xr/config/env; 'no scenario selector, no demo clock, no stand-in controls in V2'; Turbo strict env mode; unit tests environment-independent. (Slice-1 CF-01 recorded a temporary exception to this rule; it is uncommitted.)

ARCHITECTURE §16: Tailwind v4 through PostCSS chosen so Design V2 'starts on tokens, not on tooling'; E-19 design-system foundations still open ('Tailwind v4 + tokens in @xr/ui; primitives chosen at Design V2 start').
ARCHITECTURE §17: Phase 0 has no business module, no auth, no screens, no seed data.

MIGRATION_STRATEGY §1–§3: gold standard ui-ux/18-unified-functional-platform/ at 8af1f2a is the executable specification (2,202 assertions); behaviour first, screens last; screens redesigned, never ported; prototype scaffolding (scenario selector, demo controls, demo clock, stand-in completion, localStorage schema) left behind; phases: 1 flagship design (fixtures until Phase 3) → 2 domain slices D1–D8 → 3 backend (identity first; dev fixtures never production records, STK31-23) → 4 workspaces on the API → 5 cutover.

FUNCTIONAL_PARITY_MATRIX (1b090c9): 36 rows P-01…P-36; only P-13 is 'Domain (partial)'; §G excludes the scenario selector, DEMO CONTROL simulators, demo clock, stand-in completion, payment simulation, actor pointers and the localStorage chain.

OPEN_DECISIONS (1b090c9): Part A rows A-01…A-21 are stakeholder-owned and 'None may be silently resolved by an implementation' (A-20: Institute Admin vs Tenant Admin wording; A-06 completion contract; A-07 Student-facing course code; A-08 later-version chain); Part B engineering E-01…E-23 (E-19 design-system foundations, E-22 Prisma 8 gate, E-23 ESLint 9 exception); Part D deployment prerequisites D-01…D-05.
PHASE0_VERIFICATION: all foundation checks passed from a wiped build state (218 tests, e2e 2/2); the gold-standard tree hash unchanged; no commit at that time (later committed as 1b090c9).
consistentWithV46: Seven authenticated roles and no PUBLIC role in @xr/domain roles.ts (constraint 1).
No Module layer anywhere in @xr/domain or docs (constraint 2).

Runtime vocabulary and utilisation never complete from a launch; a completion needs SIMULATION_COMPLETED for an opened session; other technologies, time, resources, assessment never complete (constraint 3; B3-03 frame 3 'Completion comes only from the simulation (T-12). No “I have finished” button').
